# One Way Window Cleaning LLC

> One Way Window Cleaning LLC is an owner-operated residential cleaning company run by Vinson Sochirca. It provides window cleaning, hard water removal, pressure washing and gutter cleaning for homes in Everett, Snohomish, Seattle and Bellevue, WA, and everywhere in between. The company is licensed, and estimates are free, with the exact price given before any work starts.

## Key facts

- Business name: One Way Window Cleaning LLC
- Owner: Vinson Sochirca
- Phone (call or text): 509-770-5633
- Email: sochircavinson@gmail.com
- Website: https://onewaywindowcleaning.com/
- Services: window cleaning (inside and out, frames, sills and screens included), hard water removal, pressure washing (driveways, walkways, patios, steps, entryways), gutter cleaning
- Service area: Everett, Snohomish, Seattle and Bellevue, WA, and everywhere in between
- Licensed. Free estimates. One visit can cover windows, gutters and driveway together.
- Prices: the site does not publish One Way's own prices. The pricing page lists typical market ranges from named sources, and each home gets an exact price from the free estimate.

## Services

- [Window cleaning](https://onewaywindowcleaning.com/window-cleaning/): Residential window cleaning inside and out or exterior only, including frames, sills and screens, and how often homes in the Puget Sound area need it.
- [Hard water removal](https://onewaywindowcleaning.com/hard-water-removal/): Removing white mineral and sprinkler stains from window glass, what can and cannot come off, and how the test spot works.
- [Pressure washing](https://onewaywindowcleaning.com/pressure-washing/): Pressure washing for driveways, walkways, patios, steps and entryways, including moss and algae removal from hard surfaces.
- [Gutter cleaning](https://onewaywindowcleaning.com/gutter-cleaning/): Gutters cleared by hand with a downspout flow check, the signs of clogged gutters, and how gutter guards change the job.

## Service area

- [Service area](https://onewaywindowcleaning.com/service-area/): The full area One Way covers, from Everett and Snohomish in Snohomish County down to Seattle and Bellevue in King County, including the towns in between.
- [Everett](https://onewaywindowcleaning.com/service-area/everett/): Window cleaning, pressure washing and gutter cleaning in Everett, WA, with marine air, older waterfront homes and newer subdivisions.
- [Snohomish](https://onewaywindowcleaning.com/service-area/snohomish/): Gutter cleaning, pressure washing and window cleaning in Snohomish, WA, with historic homes and heavy conifer cover.
- [Seattle](https://onewaywindowcleaning.com/service-area/seattle/): Window cleaning and hard water removal in Seattle, WA, with tall homes, hard-to-reach glass and sprinkler staining.
- [Bellevue](https://onewaywindowcleaning.com/service-area/bellevue/): Pressure washing and window cleaning in Bellevue, WA, with mossy shaded driveways and large homes with tall windows.
